description: Our project is a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, an interactive educational game designed to teach students how astronauts survive on the Moon and Mars. Players will manage oxygen, food, water, energy, and life-support systems while facing space mission challenges. The goal is to create an engaging learning experience that promotes space science, problem-solving, and teamwork.
summary: AFFAN'S MOON MISSION is an educational space survival game designed to help students understand the challenges astronauts may face while exploring the Moon and Mars. Players learn about managing essential resources such as oxygen, food, water, and energy while making mission decisions. The project makes space science interactive and engaging while encouraging problem-solving, critical thinking, and interest in space exploration.
details: AFFAN'S MOON MISSION is an interactive educational game based on the challenge of building a sustainable lunar or Martian outpost. It is designed to help students understand how astronauts depend on life-support resources during space missions. The game focuses on managing oxygen, water, food, and energy while making decisions to keep a mission running. It aims to turn complex space exploration concepts into a simple and engaging learning experience. The project was developed with assistance from Manus AI. The main goal is to combine game-based learning with space science and encourage students to explore astronaut life, resource management, and problem-solving.
